app.title: FieldWitness
app.tagline: Rotation options for your field, each backed by three witnesses.
demo.banner: DEMO DATA — every number on this page is synthetic test data, not a real field.
fixed.judgment: FieldWitness helps you explore options. It does not replace your judgment or local agricultural advice.
region.label: Region
fields.heading: Fields in this region
fields.count: {n} fields. Pick one on the map or in this list.
field.heading: Field {id}
map.label: Map of fields in the selected region
map.attribution.none: No basemap image for this region: neutral background
error.load: Could not load {what}: {message}. Check your connection, then reload the page.
tag.legend: What the letters next to numbers mean
tag.D: Derived by a model from satellite data
scale.heading: How sharp is each data source for this field?
scale.coarse: {source}: coarser than this field, used as regional context only
scale.note: A source counts as coarse when one of its pixels is larger than a quarter of the field.
story.timeline.note: One season per harvest year. Winter wheat sown in autumn belongs to the next year.
story.crop.label: crop label
story.chart.note: Dots are cloud-free satellite views of this field. The line is the smoothed curve. Vertical lines mark green-up and end of season; the ring marks the peak.
story.series.missing: No satellite series for this field yet.
card.heading: Rotation options
card.intro: Your current rotation comes first. Each alternative shows how it differs from it.
card.excluded.current: Your current rotation breaks these choices:
card.store: Your priorities and choices are saved in this browser only.
prio.heading: What matters most to you?
prio.badYear: Do better in a bad year
cons.heading: Your farm
cons.waterCap: Seasonal water cap (mm, empty = no cap)
why.cantGrow: includes {crop}, which you can't plant or harvest
why.waterCap: water use {value} is above your cap of {cap} mm
whatif.heading: What if the weather changes?
whatif.missing: No weather what-ifs for this field yet.
whatif.active: Showing weather what-if {temp}, {rain}. Explanations below still describe today's weather.
detail.regret: Regret (loss vs the best option in each past year)
metric.bad_year_water_mm: Water use in a bad year
metric.bad_year_ryi: Relative Yield Index in a bad year
metric.residue_proxy: organic matter input (proxy, not soil carbon)
advisor.credibility: Credibility of the physics for this field
advisor.credibility.note: How well the water-balance model, calibrated on this field's own satellite history, reproduces its past seasons. 0 = not at all, 1 = perfectly.
advisor.flip: What would change the top option
advisor.flipProb: Chance that the top option changes:
advisor.witnesses: The three witnesses, option by option
advisor.witnesses.note: Each witness estimates on its own. Agreement between them sets the evidence grade.
advisor.missing: Not available yet for this option: {names}.
advisor.backtest.note: Predictions made with data up to {asof} only, then compared with what the satellite saw. Each season is centred on its prediction (the line at 0); the bar is the 90 % range. A diamond inside the bar means the observation fell inside the range.
advisor.backtest.none: No scored seasons for this field yet.
advisor.backtest.alt: Chart of observed minus predicted per season, with the 90 % range of each prediction. The table below has the same numbers.
